payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each left index l, linearly scan rightwards to find first r where substring s[l..r] contains a required pattern; then count all longer substrings starting at l.
payload.rationale: The code performs exhaustive search for each l, using a bounded k-loop (1..9) to check pattern presence. This is a complete search with a simple constant bound, best matching search_branch_and_bound among available subtypes.
